mapper.select: SELECT id, created_by_user_id AS createdByUserId, group_id AS groupId, name, link_code AS linkCode, full_url AS fullUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, domain_id AS domainId, expires_at AS expiresAt, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_fingerprint AS requestFingerprint, created_at AS createdAt FROM t_link WHERE created_by_user_id = #{userId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_link (id, created_by_user_id, group_id, name, link_code, full_url, sort_order, domain_id, expires_at, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{link.id}, #{link.createdByUserId}, #{link.groupId}, #{link.name}, #{link.linkCode}, #{link.fullUrl}, #{link.sortOrder}, #{link.domainId}, #{link.expiresAt}, #{link.idempotencyKey}, #{link.requestFingerprint}, #{link.createdAt}, #{link.createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (created_by_user_id, idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
